seo_copy.long_description: Meet the FitPulse Active Smartwatch, the smartwatch customers can't stop talking about. Buyers rate it 3.42 out of 5, and the reason comes up again and again: notifications come through instantly, very handy in meetings. In their own words: "notifications come through instantly". It offers 1.83" AMOLED display, 600 nits peak brightness. It offers bluetooth calling with built-in mic and speaker. It offers 24x7 heart rate, SpO2 and sleep tracking. It offers 100+ sports modes. It offers up to 7 days battery life (2 days with heavy calling). It offers iP68 water and dust resistance. It offers customisable watch faces. Another shopper put it simply: "bluetooth calling works really well". Whether you use it every day or only on the weekend, the FitPulse Active Smartwatch is built to keep up with real everyday routines, from long commutes to hot summers. At $57, it is priced to make the decision easy. Every order ships with a simple setup guide and our support team is one message away if you need help getting started. Add the FitPulse Active Smartwatch to your cart today and see why so many buyers recommend it to friends and family. Check the feature list above, compare it with what you pay elsewhere, and you will see why this is one of the most reviewed products in its category on our store. If it is not right for you, our hassle-free returns make trying it risk-free.
